entries.text: AC-1: docs/design/PRIVATE_REPLAY_ARCHITECTURE.md was read in full including 'Counter-review disposition'. Its own delivery-slice-1 text (section 'Delivery slices', item 1): "Phase A design: inventory UI/API/artifact dependencies; define typed privacy/fidelity policies, trusted offline export handoff, package format, isolated replay providers and agent-perspective isolation tests. Resolve coverage gaps before scoping dispatch. No live-access contract amendment is needed to begin this offline design." AC-2 dependency inventory (also recorded in project/backlog.json's note and in replay/__init__.py's own docstring): reused unchanged -- utils/support_bundle.py's Tokenizer (HMAC-SHA256, the required pseudonymization primitive per this movement's own invariant) and its network_token(); genuinely new -- the replay/ package (privacy_policy.py, isolation.py). AC-3: replay/privacy_policy.py implements a versioned FieldTreatment enum + FieldPolicy dataclass realizing the frozen document's 'Privacy compiler' table, plus PrivacyFidelityPolicy.transform(), a fail-closed tree-walker (an unclassified field, or a container value under a non-RETAIN/EXCLUDE treatment, or an unregistered SYNTHESIZE field all raise PolicyCoverageError rather than leaking the raw value) built only on the existing Tokenizer. AC-4: replay/isolation.py implements ConfinedPackageRoot (rejects absolute paths, parent traversal and symlink escapes via the same post-resolution containment check utils/runtime_paths.py already uses) plus the four explicit replay-provider interfaces the frozen document names (evidence/registry/clock/job) -- only evidence has a concrete slice-1 implementation; registry/clock/job stay interfaces for slice 3's 'isolated console providers'. AC-5: tests/test_replay_privacy_policy.py (11 tests) and tests/test_replay_isolation.py (10 tests), 21/21 passing, prove with synthetic canaries only that no raw canary value survives transformation in any position (leaf/nested-dict/list), that pseudonyms are deterministic for one export key and change with a different key, and that the confinement boundary rejects the frozen document's named agent-tool-perspective adversarial matrix (absolute path, parent traversal, symlinked file, symlinked directory) with positive controls proving the canary material genuinely exists and legitimate reads genuinely succeed. AC-6: project/backlog.json's private_replay_agent_operated_test_environment status/target/note updated to record slice 1 DELIVERED 2026-09-09 and name slice 2 (the Phase A offline exporter) as next. AC-7: not triggered -- the frozen document's slice-1 boundary was unambiguous, no Product Owner decision was needed.
